title: Gimme that love we had - What love?
style: Upbeat synth pop, energetic electronic dance with dreamy synths, catchy hooks, layered vocals]
lyrics:
[Intro]
Oh no... (synth rise)
Gimme that... gimme that...
[Verse 1 - English]
Oh no
You gotta be hiding it
Two long hours on this code
All I want is the deployed build
What do you mean "no"? Gimme-gimme it
What do you mean "no"? Gimme that code!
[Pre-Chorus]
Hey buddy
You think you can forget me? Oh no
[Chorus - English/Spanish]
Oh!
I wanna do it for the build (para el build!)
Oh!
I wanna do it for the context (para el contexto!)
Oh!
I wanna do it for the dream (para el sueño!)
Oh!
I wanna do it for the love (para el amor!)
[Verse 2 - French]
Hey toi
Tu crois pouvoir m'oublier?
Tu penses que j'oublie mon rêve? Jamais
On est en pleine bataille mentale, allez!
Qu'est-ce que tu veux dire? Donne-le moi
Donne-moi ce code!
[Chorus - English/Spanish]
Oh!
I wanna do it for the build (para el build!)
I wanna do it for the context (para el contexto!)
I wanna do it for the dream
I wanna do it for the love
[Bridge - Japanese (romaji)]
Yume wo akiramenaide
Kono ai wo
Buirudo wo kudasai...
Gimme that code!
[Drop - Multilingual]
Gimme that build! (¡Dámelo!)
Gimme that code! (Donne-le moi!)
Gimme that context! (コンテキスト!)
Gimme that love!
[Final Chorus - Korean/English]
Oh!
Build-reul wihae
Context-reul wihae
Kkum-eul wihae
Sarang-eul wihae
Oh! Gimme that build back!
[Outro]
All I want is a sweet build...
What do you mean where?
Gimme that dream
Gimme that love we had... (fade)
